beats.say: Abakcus lists 223 free physics textbooks and lecture notes from universities and physicists, sorted by subject, level, and kind.
beats.statLabel: free physics textbooks and lecture notes

beats.say: The list runs from first-year introductions like OpenStax University Physics to the Feynman Lectures, free to read on Caltech's site.
It also reaches the classics, like an 1890s university physics volume on heat, electricity, and magnetism, and a high-school book from the nonprofit CK-12.
